value.answer: Sorry you're looking for one. In Toronto, if it's for depression or anxiety, the free Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers short-term CBT, and Family Service Toronto charges sliding-scale fees based on income. For a private therapist, Psychotherapy Referral Service has connected people to registered psychotherapists since 1995, and First Session offers free consultations. I couldn't find out how long the waits are right now, or whether a crisis line near you has a number I can give. If things get harder, ConnexOntario is open 24 hours a day at 1-866-531-2600.
